skills.name: Nirvana Wall
skills.description: Moshes to loud music coming from  his headphones, creating a wall.  Good effects on allies.  *Area Physical DEF +70000 (10 sec) *Area Magical DEF +70000 (10 sec) *HP +400% (10 sec)

skills.name: Nirvana Wall, Track 4: Cage
skills.description: Traps enemies in a forcefield cage while  using his headphones to listen to music.  Bad effects on enemies.  *Enemy Skill Resistance -30% (10 sec) *Enemy Skill Use Rate -30% (10 sec) *ATK x 3500% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: Dead Account
abilities.description: Dead Account Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)
